Forget saving humanity. Let's talk about what you, personally, get out of this. You don't need to be a good person to support this plan. You just need to be selfish.

## Your Actual Odds Right Now

If you get sick (and you will), your chances of getting into a clinical trial are **0.2%**, that's 1 in 480 people with chronic disease.

![Half of dying people volunteer for experimental cures. We let 0.2% try. It's like a restaurant with 500 customers and 1 table.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-your-actual-odds-right-now-bw-academic.jpg)

Half of humanity is willing to participate [@patient-willingness-clinical-trials], but the system can only handle [5 million people per year](../appendix/clinical-trial-participants.qmd). The other 99.8% get to die while waiting for approval.

## What You Actually Get

**If you're sick, or will ever get sick:**

Instead of waiting 17 years for a cure that may never come, you get immediate access to subsidized clinical trials for every disease. Your chance of survival goes from near-zero to "actually possible."

![Wait 17 years for a cure that arrives after you're dead, or try the cure now while you're still alive to enjoy it.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-what-you-actually-get-bw-academic.jpg)

## If you're healthy (for now)

As diseases are cured, healthcare costs plummet. A 1% treaty expands clinical trial capacity by {{< var dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier >}} ({{< var trial_capacity_cumulative_years_20yr >}} trial-capacity-equivalent years in 20 years). That means cancer, heart disease, Alzheimer's, all tackled simultaneously by gene therapy, AI drug discovery, stem cells, and epigenetics.

![With treaty funding, we compress 246 years of medical progress into 20 years. It's like fast-forwarding through the boring parts, except the boring parts kill millions.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-if-you-re-healthy-for-now-bw-academic.jpg)

### If you have money

[VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds](../economics/victory-bonds.qmd) offer a projected **{{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}}**, perpetually. I could not find a comparable investment. You can profit while funding the research that will make you immortal.

![VICTORY bonds pay you money and make you live longer. It's an investment that literally keeps you alive to spend the returns.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-if-you-have-money-bw-academic.jpg)

#### If you have a family

Your parents won't die of Alzheimer's. Your children won't have to worry about rare diseases. You get to keep the people you love.

### The Math

The calculation is simple: **years of healthy life gained × economic value per healthy year**.

{{< var personal_lifetime_wealth_latex >}}

- **QALY value**: {{< var standard_economic_qaly_value_usd >}}

This uses the same methodology economists use to evaluate all health interventions.

![Give 1% of war budget, get $3 million richer, live longer, and keep your family alive. The deal is so good it sounds fake, but math doesn't lie.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-the-bottom-line-bw-academic.jpg)

It's the best deal anyone has ever offered you.

**Your choice. But choose fast.** While you were reading this, another person just died.
